summary.text: Jeff Belle, a Republican Navy veteran who works as a consultant, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in California's 52nd District to Juan Vargas.

In his Ballotpedia survey he described himself as bringing federal and local government experience and said he was focused on affordability, immigration reform, and addressing Tijuana sewage pollution in the South Bay.

paragraphs.text: Belle attended Star Spencer High School and earned a high school diploma, according to Ballotpedia. He served in the U.S. Navy from 1978 to 1980.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma City University in 2019 and a graduate degree from the American Public University System in 2021.
His career experience includes working as a consultant; in his Candidate Connection survey he described his background as combining federal experience and local experience, without further detail.
He received 30.3% of the vote to Juan Vargas's 69.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
